title: Fixing the Twin, Not the Detector: Sim-to-Real Roadside LiDAR Detection from Digital-Twin Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.26035v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Roadside LiDAR detectors are expensive to train on real labels, and digital twins promise to replace these labels, but a detector trained on a twin meets a different sensor, different objects and different annotation conventions on the real site. We describe the pipeline that placed first in the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (IEEE BigData 2026 Cup, 0.5541 combined score) and fifth on its V2X-Real track (0.8102). Every detector is a CenterPoint model trained only on synthetic data, on a single 8 GB laptop GPU. Most of the gain came from correcting differences between the twin and the real site rather than from the detector. We align the twin's coordinates, point density and box convention with the test sensor, generate the pedestrians and riders that the twins lack, plus street clutter as unlabeled negatives, and rebuild twin objects at real size and real point density. translated_title: 修正孪生数据而非检测器：基于数字孪生数据的路侧激光雷达从仿真到现实的检测
translated_abstract: 路侧激光雷达检测器使用真实标注进行训练成本高昂，数字孪生有望替代这些标注，但在孪生数据上训练的检测器在真实场地会面对不同的传感器、不同的目标以及不同的标注约定。我们描述了在UrbanTwin Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛（IEEE BigData 2026 Cup）LUMPI赛道获得第一名（综合得分0.5541）、V2X-Real赛道获得第五名（0.8102）的完整技术流程。所有检测器均为CenterPoint模型，仅使用合成数据训练，运行在单块8 GB笔记本GPU上。大部分性能提升来自修正孪生数据与真实场地之间的差异，而非来自检测器本身。我们将孪生数据的坐标系、点密度和边界框约定与测试传感器对齐，生成孪生数据中缺失的行人和骑行者，并将街道杂波作为无标注负样本，同时以真实尺寸和真实点密度重建孪生目标。一种非学习的重采样方法……
tldr: 该论文的核心创新在于修正数字孪生数据与真实场景之间的差异（对齐坐标系、点密度和标注约定，补全缺失的行人与骑行者并以真实尺寸和点密度重建目标），而非改进检测器本身，从而使仅用合成数据在单块8GB笔记本GPU上训练的CenterPoint模型在UrbanTwin Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛LUMPI赛道夺得第一名。
en_tdlr: By fixing the twin rather than the detector—aligning coordinates, point density, and annotation conventions with the real sensor, generating missing pedestrians and riders, and rebuilding twin objects at real size and density—a CenterPoint model trained purely on synthetic data on a single 8 GB laptop GPU won first place in the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge.
